brand.$description: Pesa Red. A fill only: the lead (hero) card and the one main action per screen, plus danger. White text on it: 5.9:1.

brandLink.$description: Links and secondary actions: the text colour, with a chevron.

background.$description: Warm page tone so white cards stand off it.

success.$description: Fills and icons. For success text on white use successText.

danger.$description: Same red as brand; always pair with an icon or label ("Over").

markBlue.$description: Only for marking the parts of a message (who). 5.6:1 on its tint.

markPurple.$description: Only for marking the parts of a message (balance). 5.8:1 on its tint.

markTeal.$description: Only for marking the parts of a message (fee). 4.6:1 on its tint.

floating.$description: Tab bar, sheets, menus, popups. No drop shadows in dark.

text.$description: Moderate, not maximal, contrast: 12.5:1 on surface.

brand.$description: Same red as light, a fill only.

onBrand.$description: White text on the red fill (5.9:1).

brandLink.$description: Links and secondary actions: the text colour.

danger.$description: Same as dark brand; always pair with an icon or label.
